title: MetroMart Mumbai listing gain - Rolled Oats 1kg
text: MetroMart (modern trade chain) has added Rolled Oats 1kg to its Mumbai planogram across 120 stores. First orders ship W097 (w/c 2026-08-10). Listing is permanent; expect a sustained step-up in Mumbai DC volume for the 1kg pack.

title: GrainCo launches value muesli in Delhi NCR
text: Competitor GrainCo launched a 400g fruit muesli at an 18% lower shelf price in Delhi NCR from W096 (w/c 2026-08-03). Early trade feedback suggests share loss for our Fruit Muesli 400g in the north.

title: Bengaluru buy-one-get-one on Granola Bar 6-pack
text: BOGO promotion on Granola Bar 6-pack at Bengaluru key accounts, W101 (w/c 2026-09-07) to W102 (w/c 2026-09-14) only. One-off; no follow-on activity planned. Expect pantry loading and a short dip afterwards.

title: Festive promotion - Masala Popcorn 150g, Mumbai
text: Diwali-season 25% off promotion on Masala Popcorn 150g across Mumbai modern trade, W106 (w/c 2026-10-12) to W108 (w/c 2026-10-26). Confirmed with retailer; POS material printed. Category team expects roughly +60% uplift in promo weeks.

title: Festive promotion - Masala Popcorn 150g, Delhi
text: Planned Diwali-season 25% off promotion on Masala Popcorn 150g in Delhi NCR modern trade, W106 (w/c 2026-10-12) to W108 (w/c 2026-10-26). Category team expects roughly +60% uplift in promo weeks.

title: Update: Delhi popcorn activity
text: Retailer budget for the Delhi NCR festive window has been reallocated to beverages. The planned Masala Popcorn 150g activity will not go ahead this season.

title: Price increase - Rolled Oats 500g, East
text: List price of Rolled Oats 500g rises 12% in the East region from W095 (w/c 2026-07-27); 1kg price unchanged. Trade expects shoppers to trade up to the 1kg pack, which is now better value per kg.

title: MetroMart Mumbai moves to monthly replenishment
text: From W093 (w/c 2026-07-13), MetroMart Mumbai places one consolidated order at the start of each month for Fruit Muesli 750g instead of weekly orders. Monthly volume unchanged; weekly pattern will be lumpy.

title: Mumbai oats sampling drive
text: In-store sampling for Rolled Oats 500g in Mumbai, W090 (w/c 2026-06-22) to W091 (w/c 2026-06-29). Small activity, minimal volume impact expected.

title: Industry report: oats demand rising nationally
text: An industry tracker reports that oats consumption in urban India grew in double digits this year, driven by health positioning. Growth is broad-based across metros. No company-specific activity.

title: Cake mix demand in the East is institutional
text: Most Eggless Cake Mix volume through Kolkata DC goes to small bakeries and caterers who order irregularly and in bulk. Weekly demand is lumpy with many zero weeks; aggregate monthly volume is stable.

title: Delhi DC stock-out - Granola Bar 12-pack
text: Packaging shortage caused a stock-out of Granola Bar 12-pack at Delhi DC in W070 (w/c 2026-02-02) to W071 (w/c 2026-02-09). Resolved.

title: Festive season outlook
text: Festive season (Navratri to Diwali) typically lifts Snacks and Baking volumes across all regions in October-November. Baseline forecasts already include normal seasonality.

title: Bengaluru flooding - delivery disruption
text: Heavy rain disrupted secondary deliveries from Bengaluru DC in W080 (w/c 2026-04-13). Volumes recovered the following week.

title: Planogram review scheduled - Delhi snacks bay
text: A key Delhi account will review its snacks planogram in W110 (w/c 2026-11-09). No change to ranging yet.

title: GrainCo deepens price cut
text: GrainCo cut its 400g muesli price by a further 7% in Delhi NCR from W100 (w/c 2026-08-31), widening the gap to 25%.

title: Rolled Oats 500g weekend offer - Mumbai only
text: Weekend price-off on Rolled Oats 500g in Mumbai modern trade, W103 (w/c 2026-09-21) to W104 (w/c 2026-09-28). Mumbai only.

title: Corn input cost update
text: Corn input costs rose 6% this quarter. No list-price change planned for popcorn this year.

title: Quick-commerce growth in Bengaluru
text: Quick-commerce platforms now account for a growing share of Bengaluru orders. Order sizes are smaller and more frequent.

title: Possible listing - Granola Bar 6-pack, Kolkata
text: Early-stage discussion with a Kolkata chain about listing Granola Bar 6-pack next year. Nothing agreed.
